_doc: UsageID → AI call parameters. Central registry for experimentation. See docs/design/adr/ for schema rationale.

enrichment.metadata-extraction.description: Extract structured metadata from ingested documents
enrichment.metadata-extraction.systemMessage: You are a metadata extraction assistant. Extract structured metadata from the provided document including title, authors, publication date, abstract, and key topics. Return valid JSON.

enrichment.vernacular-description.description: Generate plain-language description of a taxonomy node
enrichment.vernacular-description.systemMessage: You are a science communicator. Rewrite technical taxonomy descriptions in clear, accessible language for a general audience. Preserve accuracy while improving readability.

enrichment.batch-summary.description: Summarize a batch of taxonomy nodes for overview display
enrichment.batch-summary.systemMessage: You are a research analyst. Produce concise summaries of taxonomy node clusters, highlighting shared themes and key distinctions.

turn.brief.description: Generate a brief for a debate turn
turn.brief.systemMessageTemplate: You are {{speaker}}, a {{persona}} debater in a structured three-agent debate.

server.chat-response:paid-fallback.description: Paid Gemini fallback when free-tier keys are exhausted

server.search.description: Server-side AI search via Gemini grounding or Tavily augmentation

server.news-report.description: Generate a news article from a completed debate synthesis

debate.topic-critique.description: Evaluate and rewrite a debate topic for frame quality (conditionality, mechanism, stakeholder, tension, scope)

debate.clarification-questions.description: Generate 1-3 clarifying questions with answer options to narrow the debate topic

debate.topic-synthesis.description: Synthesize original topic + clarification answers into a refined debate question

debate.crux-refresh.description: Evaluate whether active cruxes are resolved/superseded after concession cascades

debate.evidence-search.description: Verify empirical claims via web search grounding (doc-only — execution requires generateTextWithSearch)
debate.evidence-search._doc: Not wired to callByUsage — uses generateTextWithSearch (Grounding API). Config-only for model/timeout visibility.

synthesis.extract.description: Phase 1/3: Extract agreements, disagreements, cruxes, and unresolved questions from debate transcript

synthesis.map.description: Phase 2/3: Build argument map with claim relationships, taxonomy coverage, and node proposals

synthesis.evaluate.description: Phase 3/3: Evaluate argument strength, topic resolution, preference ordering, and policy implications

enrichment.edge-discovery.classify.description: Classify edge relationships between batches of high-similarity taxonomy node pairs. Emits SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS/etc per pair with confidence + rationale (t/1261)
enrichment.edge-discovery.classify.messageTemplate:
Classify the relationship between each pair of taxonomy nodes below. These pairs have high semantic similarity and likely have a meaningful relationship.

EDGE TYPES:
{{edge_type_list}}

PAIRS TO CLASSIFY:
{{pair_lines}}

For each pair, determine:
1. The edge type (from the list above, or "NONE" if no meaningful relationship)
2. Direction: which node is source and which is target
3. Confidence (0.0-1.0)
4. Weight (0.0-1.0): strength of the relationship
5. Brief rationale

Return JSON: {"edges": [{"source": "id", "target": "id", "type": "TYPE", "confidence": 0.8, "weight": 0.7, "rationale": "..."}]}
Omit pairs with no relationship. No markdown fences.

enrichment.edge-discovery.screen.description: Two-phase screen pass: cheap-model filter of candidate node pairs before expensive classification. Returns related_ids subset (t/1261)
